extensionDescription.message: Synchronize Evolution Data Server contacts with Thunderbird using a separately installed local helper.

helperIntro.message: The extension cannot access Evolution Data Server on its own. Install

consentLabel.message: I authorize the extension to exchange my contact cards locally with EDS Contacts Helper for synchronization. Neither the extension nor the helper sends contacts over the Internet.

reverseSyncLabel.message: Also copy new contacts created in Thunderbird’s “Evolution” address book to EDS

deleteMissingLabel.message: Delete previously synchronized contacts from Thunderbird when they disappear from EDS

thunderbirdChangesNotice.message: Changes and deletions made in Thunderbird are not currently propagated to EDS.

diagnosticsConsent.message: The test reads EDS contacts only after you give consent.

settingsLoaded.message: Settings loaded. The helper is contacted only after you give consent.
